messages:
mika: quick copy check — tooltip for the rollout slider label 'Canary weight'. usability tests show people aren't sure what it does. posting two short options, pls thumbs/quick edits

mika: ```Option A:
Canary weight — Percentage of incoming traffic routed to the canary. In-flight requests continue on the previous version; new requests use the canary immediately. Set to 0% to stop the canary.

Option B (short):
Canary weight — How much incoming traffic is routed to the canary. In-flight requests finish on the old version. Set to 0% to disable.```

anya: I like A for clarity but we should avoid 'previous' vs 'old' inconsistency. also 'stop the canary' sounds a bit blunt. maybe: 'Set to 0% to stop routing to the canary.' :thinking:

sam: accessibility nit — tooltip text should be under 140 chars ideally for screen reader brevity. Also add an aria label suggestion: `aria-label="Canary traffic weight"`.

tariq: tech note: in-flight requests are drained (we wait up to 30s then force-close), so 'finish' is accurate for most cases but we should avoid promising unlimited time. maybe say 'finish on the previous version or drain within ~30s'.

mika: ok combining feedback. new draft: ```Canary weight — Percentage of incoming traffic routed to the canary. Existing in-flight requests finish on the previous version (drained within ~30s). New requests use the canary immediately. Set to 0% to stop routing to the canary.```

anya: LGTM but trim a little: remove 'immediately' (implied) and change 'stop routing to the canary' -> 'disable the canary' for brevity.

sam: still ~200 chars. here's a shorter accessible variant that keeps the key bits: ```Canary weight — Percent of incoming traffic routed to the canary. In-flight requests finish on the previous version (drained within ~30s). Set to 0% to disable the canary.```

designbot: suggestion: shorten further for tooltip UI: ```Canary weight — % of incoming traffic routed to canary. In-flight requests finish on the previous version (drained within ~30s). Set to 0% to disable.```

mika: perfect — I'll push the last one into the UI and add the aria-label Sam suggested. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
